description_en: Edits a quota throttling rule on a gateway
description_zh: 编辑网关上某条配额限流规则
kebab_example: aliyun apig update-gateway-quota-rule --gateway-id gw-123456 --rule-id qr-d8j7fpmm1hks65xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGatewayQuotaRule

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The list of principal (consumer) IDs to bind
parameters.help_zh: 新增绑定主体（消费者）ID列表
parameters.name: add_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of principal (consumer) IDs to unbind
parameters.name: remove_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run only without persisting or applying the configuration. A dry run checks whether conflicting rules exist on the bound consumers. For example, a consumer that already has a calendar-day quota cannot have another calendar-day quota rule added
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅预检（预检不下发实际配置），用于检查绑定的消费者上是否存在冲突的规则（同一消费者不能配置两个相同周期的自然周期配额，例如已有自然日配额的消费者不能再新增一个自然日配额规则）
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when a conflict exists. If overwriting is allowed, the conflicting principals (consumers) are unbound from the old rule and bound to the new rule
parameters.help_zh: 冲突时是否允许覆盖。注意如果选择允许覆盖，冲突主体（消费者）会从旧规则解绑并绑定到新规则
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en:
The conflict snapshot hash, used to prevent concurrent dirty overwrites when confirming an overwrite. Obtain this value from the response of a prior dryRun=true call.

This parameter is not required in the following cases: no conflicts exist, the call is a dry run (dryRun=true), or overwrite is set to false.

When dryRun is set to false and overwrite is set to true, if this parameter is missing or the value has expired and no longer matches, the backend returns accepted=false with a new conflict preview. Perform the dry run again to confirm the new conflicts
parameters.help_zh:
冲突快照哈希，用于“确认覆盖时防并发脏覆盖”。通过先执行 dryRun=true 在返回数据提取。

当以下情况不需要填写：没有冲突；只是 dryRun=true 预检；overwrite=false，即不确认覆盖。

当当 dryRun = false 且 overwrite=true 时不带改参数或者该参数过期不匹配，后端会返回：accepted=false 并带新的冲突预览，需要重新执行 dryrun 确认新的冲突
parameters.name: conflict_hash

parameters.help_en: The list of consumer group IDs. This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 消费者组ID列表（暂不支持）
parameters.name: consumer_group_ids

v1_parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
v1_parameters.name: gatewayId
